title: Odd cycles in coprime graphs: an answer to a question of Erdős and Sárközy. Lean 4 proof, paper and scripts

creators.name: Bhattacharjee, Deep
creators.affiliation: Formerly, Electro-Gravitational Space Propulsion Laboratory (EGSPL), Bhubaneswar, Odisha 751030, India

creators.name: Mandal, Priyabrata
creators.affiliation: Department of Mathematics, Bioinformatics and Computer Applications, Maulana Azad National Institute of Technology Bhopal, Bhopal 462003, India

description:
We prove that for every sufficiently large n, every set A ⊆ {1, …, n} with more than ⌊n/2⌋ + ⌊n/3⌋ − ⌊n/6⌋ elements has a coprime graph containing cycles of all odd lengths from 3 to n/3 + 1. This answers Question 1 of Erdős Problem 883, posed by Erdős and Sárközy.

The archive contains the complete Lean 4 proof (theorem ErdosSar.question1, Lean 4.34.1 with Mathlib 4.34.1), whose axioms are only propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound, with no sorry and no native_decide; the paper with its LaTeX source, TikZ figures and generated tables; and the Python and C scripts that reproduce every table and figure.
